description: This file defines a PHP class 'ConfigurationProvider' within the AWS SDK that provides various methods to generate configuration objects for AWS endpoints, including default, environment-based, ini file-based, and fallback configurations. It handles the logic for reading environment variables, ini files, and default fallbacks for the 'use fips endpoint' configuration in the AWS SDK context.

classes.name: ConfigurationProvider
classes.description: A static class providing methods to generate AWS configuration providers handling environment variables, ini files, and default fallbacks, mainly for 'use fips endpoint' configurations.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Creates a default configuration provider that checks environment variables, shared config files, and fallback options, with optional caching.

methods.name: env
methods.description: Provides a configuration provider that reads the configuration from environment variables.

methods.name: ini
methods.description: Provides a configuration provider that reads config from an ini file, specified by profile and filename.

methods.name: fallback
methods.description: Provides fallback configuration options based on the given region.
